sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 15

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 15:1
items.html: The lights that are included in the Partzuf by way of its incorporation with the Partzuf above it, or by way of transmission to the one below it, and that are not of the substance of its own structure, are called illumination and not the essential — that is, that they are not of the essence of its structure. (ibid.)
